test_cases.description: Proposed test design based on the supplied requirement. Page behaviour and initial state require review; no browser execution is claimed.
preconditions: Open the application and navigate to the Skills section.
Ensure Selenium and Playwright are initially unchecked.

steps.expected: Selenium is checked and Playwright remains unchecked.

steps.action: Select Playwright while Selenium is still selected.
steps.expected: Both Playwright and Selenium are checked; selecting Playwright does not clear Selenium.
Selenium is unchecked and Playwright remains checked.
Both Selenium and Playwright are unchecked.

acceptance_criteria: Selecting Playwright preserves an existing Selenium selection.
Deselecting Selenium preserves an existing Playwright selection.
